strategies.name: Common Goal (collaborative)
strategies.description: Agents share one objective and pass results forward; every agent runs and its result is merged. No contention or arbitration.
strategies.when_to_use: The agent contributes a distinct piece toward the goal and its output is combined with the others -- no fighting over a limited resource. This is the default; use it whenever no other strategy's condition is clearly met.

strategies.name: Bidding
strategies.description: Agents contending in the same level bid for one scarce unit by returning a score; the single highest bidder commits (acts for real) and every loser is skipped.
strategies.when_to_use: Two or more agents in the SAME level compete for one scarce unit that only ONE may take (e.g. several patients contending for a single free ICU bed, one ambulance for two simultaneous calls) and exactly one should win while the rest stand down. Do NOT use it when each agent has its own distinct job.
